title: 2. Supersede R-119: joint adaptation with matched boundary controls
hypothesis: Co-adapting the residual with re-capture improves post-recovery rolling beyond what continued module-only optimization achieves.

prediction.against: MODULE_WIDE: matched 24-update module-only ARS from config/pen_spin/r118_continue_finalist/
prediction.rationale:
JOINT minus MODULE_WIDE isolates co-adaptation; MODULE_ORIGINAL additionally separates relaxed bounds from ordinary continuation. This supersedes deferred R-119 because D-082 now establishes the simpler structure and a substantially stronger qualified parent; neither D-082 nor the frozen-residual plateau tests this coupling.

FROZEN SPECIFICATION (triage rounds 1-2, agreed). Parent: config/pen_spin/r118_continue_finalist/finalist.json (the R-106 finalist plus the 11-parameter single-decision re-capture module; hash verified). ARMS, 24 ARS updates each, one persistent process per arm, same placements cases.placements(4998, 12288) (512 per update), terminal means frozen and hashed, no selection:
 MODULE_ORIGINAL: the 11 module parameters with the R-116 ranges (plain continuation).
 MODULE_WIDE: the same 11 with two ranges widened: threshold [1, 6] rad/s (was [1, 4]) and ramp-out [3, 80] steps (was [10, 80]); the parent's physical parameter values are unchanged, re-expressed in the new normalised coordinates, and the smoke verifies that the re-expressed module reproduces the parent's actions in lockstep.
 JOINT: MODULE_WIDE's 11 coordinates followed by the residual's 32 coefficients in the unit coordinate y = (theta + 0.10)/0.20 (coefficient bound 0.10 and residual cap 0.10 unchanged), 43 coordinates; initial point = the parent.
 Learner: ARS in normalised coordinates with clipping projection, 4 antithetic directions all used, 512 shared placements per signed candidate, return = sustained-success fraction; nu 0.1 and alpha 0.05 in the ORIGINAL normalised units: in the two widened coordinates the perturbation and the update are multiplied by (original range / widened range) = 3/5 for the threshold and 70/77 for the ramp-out, so every arm perturbs and steps each module parameter by the same physical amount; for the residual coordinates nu 0.1 and alpha 0.05 are exactly R-106's 0.02 and 0.01 in coefficient units. Directions: one (4, 43) standard-normal draw per update from default_rng(4998 + 2000); the module arms use its first 11 columns.
 Smoke (seed 4997): MODULE_WIDE's and JOINT's initial policies equal the parent in lockstep (bit for bit for JOINT's residual part; module schedule within 1e-5); a perturbed residual coordinate changes the action; a threshold above 4 rad/s can trigger; state reset; scorer; A/A.
 Confirmation, once, twelve 128-case manifests (seeds 4999-5010), fresh process per cell: D-072 reference, R-106 root, CONTINUE parent, and the three finalists (1,536 pairs per contrast).
 CONTRASTS, one eight-member Holm family on the two-sided case-paired t tests: JOINT minus MODULE_WIDE (primary), MODULE_WIDE minus MODULE_ORIGINAL (what the bounds buy), each finalist minus the CONTINUE parent (3) and minus D-072 (3). Qualification of a finalist (round-3 correction): Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND a strictly positive paired success-interval lower bound against BOTH the CONTINUE parent and D-072 (both contrasts are members of the eight-contrast family), and one-sided 95% upper bounds on the paired drop-rate difference <= 0.05 against both the parent and D-072. Case-paired and manifest-clustered intervals reported for all.
POWER (frozen before approval; normal approximation; SE = sqrt(q - 0.05^2)/sqrt(1536) with q the fraction of discordant pairs; the most conservative Holm step uses two-sided alpha 0.05/8, critical z = 2.73). Target power 0.80 for a true +0.05 JOINT-minus-MODULE_WIDE difference. Anticipated q: 0.064 (the recorded discordance between two finalists continued from one parent, RETRY vs CONTINUE in R-118: 98 of 1,536), SE 0.0063, power > 0.999; at q = 0.135 (CONTINUE vs its parent R-116: 207 of 1,536), SE 0.0093, power 0.996; sensitivity: at q = 0.30, SE 0.0139, power 0.80 (the target is met for any q <= 0.30); at q = 0.41 (the largest discordance recorded between two policies, R-104), SE 0.0163, power 0.63. This is power to establish POSITIVITY of a true +0.05 effect. Precision for the predicted magnitude is a different matter: the 95% interval half-width is 0.012 at q = 0.064 and 0.027 at q = 0.30, so 'at least +0.05' (lower bound >= 0.05) is demonstrated with 50% probability only if the true effect is about +0.062 (q = 0.064) to +0.077 (q = 0.30), and the registered refutation (upper bound < 0.05) is reached with 80% probability if the true effect is at most about +0.032 (q = 0.064). 1,536 pairs are therefore kept.
BUDGET: training 3 x 24 x about 8,200 = 590,400 starts; smoke 8,200; confirmation 6 x 1,536 cases charged at 2 = 18,432: about 617,000; hard ceiling 640,000 enforced before every rollout; a started seeded child is never relaunched. Seeds 4997 (smoke), 4998 (training), 4999-5010 (confirmation). Supersedes deferred R-119, whose reserved seeds are not used.

falsified_by: The upper paired 95% confidence bound for JOINT-minus-MODULE_WIDE is below 0.05. An interval including zero is not evidence of improvement; failure of the strict success or drop gate prevents qualification regardless of the point estimate.

approval.note: The matched arms separate ordinary continuation, boundary relief and residual–recovery co-adaptation, superseding R-119 from the stronger qualified parent rather than repeating the frozen-residual plateau tests. I accept the implementer's corrected qualification gate against both CONTINUE and D-072;

result.notes: No deviation in the registered protocol; one accounting note: the smoke used three rollouts (12,300 starts) where the estimate assumed two (8,200); total charged 621,402 of 640,000. Smoke passed first time (the widened-range module and the joint policy reproduce the parent in lockstep within 1e-5; the probe with threshold 6 rad/s and shifted residual coefficients changes actions and triggers more). All three arms ran 24 updates on seed 4998's placements with shared direction draws and physically matched module step sizes; terminal means frozen before confirmation; six policies confirmed once on twelve fresh manifests (seeds 4999-5010). Sustained success of 1,536: reference 661 (0.430), R-106 root 812 (0.529), CONTINUE parent 1,148 (0.747), MODULE_ORIGINAL 1,180 (0.768), MODULE_WIDE 1,192 (0.776), JOINT 1,238 (0.806); drops 80 / 49 / 76 / 82 / 75 / 70. Registered contrast JOINT minus MODULE_WIDE: +0.030 [+0.008, +0.052], Holm p 0.015, manifest-clustered [+0.020, +0.040], 171 wins and 125 losses: a positive co-adaptation effect is established, but the interval contains values on both sides of +0.05 (upper bound 0.0519), so the registered five-point magnitude is neither supported nor refuted. Boundary relief: MODULE_WIDE minus MODULE_ORIGINAL +0.008 [-0.004, +0.020] (not established). Every finalist qualifies under the registered rule (Holm p < 0.05 with a positive lower bound against both the CONTINUE parent and D-072, and drop bounds within 0.05 against both): MODULE_ORIGINAL +0.021 [+0.007, +0.034], MODULE_WIDE +0.029 [+0.016, +0.042], JOINT +0.059 [+0.035, +0.082] over the parent. Notable: training-time candidate success was flat for all three arms (about 0.72-0.76 throughout, on changing placements), yet all three finalists are better than the parent on fresh cases; the per-update means are averages over perturbed candidates and are a poor progress indicator. JOINT moved the residual by an L2 of 0.171 (largest single coefficient change 0.081) and its module ends with threshold 4.18 rad/s, ramp-out 6.3 steps, little-finger depth 0.0, stroke multiplier 1.45; discordance JOINT vs MODULE_WIDE was 296/1,536 = 0.19, three times the 0.064 anticipated, which is why the interval is wider than planned (SE 0.011). The CONTINUE parent replicates on new cases: +0.219 over the root (337 wins, 1 loss) and +0.317 over the reference. One matched set of ARS trajectories from one parent; a single confirmation.

verdicts.reasoning: JOINT minus MODULE_WIDE is +0.030 paired sustained success with a 95% interval [+0.008, +0.052] over 1,536 fresh pairs (171 wins, 125 losses), Holm-adjusted p 0.015 in the eight-contrast family, manifest-clustered [+0.020, +0.040]. Co-adaptation of the residual with the module therefore has an established POSITIVE effect, but the registered prediction is a five-point increase: the interval's upper bound (0.0519) is not below 0.05, so the magnitude is not refuted, and its lower bound is far from 0.05, so it is not supported: inconclusive on the registered magnitude, with the point estimate at three points. Beside it: all three finalists qualify against the CONTINUE parent and D-072 under the registered rule; JOINT is the best controller so far at 0.806 sustained success (+0.059 [+0.035, +0.082] over the parent, drops 70 vs 76); widening the two bounds is not established as helpful (+0.008 [-0.004, +0.020]).
verdicts.next_experiment: Freeze the JOINT finalist as the best qualified controller (0.81 sustained success against the reference's 0.43); installing it is the user's call. The ladder under this direction is now: reference 0.43 -> residual (R-106) 0.53-0.55 -> re-capture module (R-116) 0.64 -> continued (R-118) 0.74-0.75 -> joint (R-121) 0.81. Remaining failures should be re-audited on this archive (how many persistent slow, unsteady, early drops remain) before the next structural idea; the 46-per-1,536 early drops (capture before step 60) are untouched by everything so far and are the most obvious separate lever.

verdicts.reasoning: JOINT minus the named MODULE_WIDE control increased paired success by 0.02995, with case-paired 95% CI [0.00802, 0.05187] and Holm-adjusted p = 0.01492, establishing a positive difference [logs/pen_spin/r121_recovery_joint/summary.json]. However, the registered 0.05 magnitude is neither supported nor refuted: the interval crosses that threshold, and its upper bound does not meet the registered refutation condition [logs/pen_spin/r121_recovery_joint/summary.json]. The manifest-clustered interval [0.02029, 0.03961] falls below 0.05, but substituting this secondary interval would change the registered decision rule [logs/pen_spin/r121_recovery_joint/summary.json]. Separately, JOINT passes the recorded success and drop qualification gates against both CONTINUE and the reference; qualification does not establish the predicted magnitude against MODULE_WIDE [logs/pen_spin/r121_recovery_joint/summary.json].

Use the frozen D-072-qualified controller as the experimental reference, without changing the saved default incumbent. First compare independent parameter draws, ARS/CEM and PPO on one identical sparse, state-conditioned symbolic residual family. If an inner learner produces a confirmed useful gain, compare fixed structure, grammar-based structural evolution and LLM-guided structural evolution with that learner and inherited parameters. Investigate compact memory or anchored component replacement only when the preceding results motivate them. Preserve the task, frozen evaluation manifests and strict paired promotion/drop criteria. Run one protocol at a time. No controller-generation LLM calls during P1; advisor calls for the research loop remain allowed. Later controller-generation calls need an agreed protocol and explicit call budget. Do not repeat R-102, retune its confirmation cases, reopen cold whole-controller generation, or resume expert cloning. Continue evidence-driven follow-ups within this direction through the existing loop, including its escalation and exhaustion rules.
